title: Polling and Interrupt Handling
lead: Part 1 (unchanged): lecture 04 and exercise 3 from this year's slides and peer notes: polling (system 5), interrupts, vector table, ISR, sei/cli, INT0/INT1 (system 6), debouncing, pin change interrupts (system 7), attachInterrupt, the click counter. Part 2 (added): the same topics explained from zero for beginners with diagrams, and section L: what the lecturer said in the 2020 recordings.
